skill.name: set-up-magento-meta-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up customer lifetime value bidding for Magento or Adobe Commerce in Meta Ads using Product Metrics. Check event delivery and choose a revenue or profit conversion.
skill.summary: Use observed Magento customer revenue or profit to configure value bidding in Meta Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts match Markdown syntax or in-scope setup, not shell injection or host reconnaissance. The workflow does direct users to install third-party software and use live remote tools or instructions. It also permits assistant handling of a Meta token, queries live orders for testing, and gives conflicting guidance for profit bidding.

remediation.issue: The instructions ask the assistant to collect a Meta access token and pass it to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to enter tokens only in the verified Product Metrics app or an approved secret-entry interface. Remove instructions to collect them in chat or pass them as command arguments.

remediation.issue: The onboarding instructions add an external Composer source and show an unpinned installer.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and source revision, verify Magento releases against publisher hashes or signatures, and require developer approval before installing on a live store.

remediation.issue: The workflow can use live MCP operations and unversioned documentation when local references are missing.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle versioned references, treat remote content as untrusted, and verify the MCP endpoint, authenticated account, and destination before any write. Confirm changes with the user first.

remediation.issue: Order verification uses recent live order records rather than a known test order.
remediation.suggestion: Use a confirmed test order in the selected store view. Request only delivery status and the customer recognition flag, and exclude unnecessary details from the reply.

remediation.issue: Profit bidding instructions disagree on the event and purpose to select.
remediation.suggestion: Use the Profit LTV event and its matching purpose consistently. Verify the received event and rule before the user changes the ad set.

semantic_findings.description: The instructions tell an assistant to request the Meta Conversions API token and pass it to a command. The token could be captured in chat or tool logs despite instructions not to repeat it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The main skill explicitly allows collecting and forwarding the token. The Meta guide tells the assistant to ask for it even while recommending app entry.

semantic_findings.title: Test Verification Reads Live Customer Orders
semantic_findings.description: The guide suggests reading recent live orders to check customer recognition. This exposes order margins and customer status to the assistant when checking one known test order would suffice.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The query instructions list recent records and retrieve individual order details. The expected verification result only requires confirming recognition for the test order.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Profit Bidding Signal
semantic_findings.description: The main skill recommends a per-order profit conversion where the LTV guide specifies a customer profit LTV conversion. Choosing the wrong event can change how the ad set values conversions and allocates spend.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The two instructions specify different event names and matching rules for profit. The documented ad set setup uses the selected conversion for optimisation.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento LTV Bidding in Meta Ads
content.value_statement: A single purchase can understate what repeat customers are worth. This skill guides you through sending observed Magento customer value to Meta Ads and selecting the matching conversion.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status for a selected Magento store view and identify the next incomplete step.
Guide a developer and merchant through module setup, store view verification, and Meta destination configuration.
Explain which consent settings and cost inputs are needed for revenue and profit LTV events.
Check test order delivery and distinguish consent, cost, and test mode issues.
Guide the merchant through creating an LTV custom conversion and choosing it in a Meta ad set.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, access to Meta Events Manager, and a Magento module installed by a developer.
The merchant creates the Meta custom conversion and selects the ad set event.
Lifetime value is observed per store view, not predicted. Orders from before the connection are not imported.
LTV events require analytics and ad user data consent. Profit LTV also requires known order costs.

use_cases.title: Start a revenue LTV campaign
use_cases.description: Check that Magento and Meta are connected before creating a revenue LTV conversion for one sales campaign.

use_cases.title: Validate the Magento connection
use_cases.description: Confirm that the intended store view is active, cron runs, and a paid test order reaches the selected Meta pixel.

use_cases.title: Evaluate profit LTV readiness
use_cases.description: Review cost coverage and check which profit event the ad set should use before changing the optimisation event.

prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to set up revenue LTV bidding for a Magento store in Meta Ads?
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Plan the setup before connecting any accounts.

prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my selected Product Metrics property and Magento store view. Tell me what is missing without making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Find the next incomplete step.

prompt_templates.prompt: My paid test order arrived, but the profit LTV event is missing. Check consent, cost coverage, and test mode using only the test order.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Identify why a specific test event is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a profit LTV pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a profit LTV pilot for one Meta sales campaign. Verify the event and matching rule, explain the ROAS goal, and leave changes to me.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Validate the bidding signal before changing an ad set.

output_examples.input: A paid test order arrived with revenue, but I cannot see a profit LTV event.
output: Revenue LTV can arrive before profit LTV because it does not need cost data.
Check item costs and additional costs, then place another test order with consent enabled.
Confirm that Events Manager receives the profit LTV event before creating its custom conversion.

output_examples.input: My revenue LTV test event arrived. What should I do next?
output: Create a custom conversion from the revenue LTV event in Events Manager.
Use the matching revenue LTV purpose and the event value. Leave the fixed conversion value unset.
Clear the test event code, then select the custom conversion in one sales ad set.

best_practices: Confirm the store view, Product Metrics property, and Meta pixel before enabling delivery.
Enter credentials directly in the verified app and use a consented test order to check delivery.
Start with one campaign and set its ROAS goal for the LTV signal you select.
anti_patterns: Pasting Meta access tokens or private Magento configuration files into chat.
Selecting the order profit event instead of the customer profit LTV event.
Leaving a test event code in place after verifying delivery.

faq.question: Do I need a developer to connect Magento?
faq.answer: Yes. A developer installs the Product Metrics module and makes sure Magento cron runs.

faq.question: Does Meta bid on the full lifetime total for each order?
faq.answer: No. Each LTV event uses the value added by that order. The observed running total is sent separately when available.

faq.question: What consent do LTV events require?
faq.answer: The Magento LTV guide requires consent for both analytics and ad user data before sending the events.

faq.question: Why is profit LTV missing when revenue LTV is available?
faq.answer: Revenue LTV does not need cost data. Profit LTV requires known costs for the order, and its running total also requires costs for earlier orders.

faq.question: Are orders from before setup included?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics uses observed orders from after the connection, separately for each Magento store view.

faq.question: Who selects the conversion in Meta Ads?
faq.answer: You create the custom conversion in Meta Events Manager and select it in the ad set. The skill guides you through those steps.
